zh.title: 如果地球上的樹全部消失
zh.summary: 樹全部消失，我們不會窒息：就算全燒光，氧氣也只從 20.95% 降到約 20.93%。真正的麻煩是樹裡約 3000 億噸的碳、亞馬遜每天送上天的 200 億噸水，和以森林為家的物種；而人類文明開始以來，樹已少了將近一半。

youtube.title: 如果地球上的樹全部消失，我們會窒息嗎？
youtube.description:
樹全部消失，我們不會窒息，真正的麻煩在別處。

地球上約有 3 兆棵樹，平均每人約 370 棵。就算把它們全燒光，空氣中的氧氣也只會從 20.95% 降到約 20.93%；但樹木與樹根裡約 3000 億噸的碳，相當於全球燒化石燃料 29 年的排放。亞馬遜的樹每天把約 200 億噸水送上天空，比亞馬遜河每天流進大海的水還多；森林也是 80% 兩棲類、75% 鳥類、68% 哺乳類物種的家。而人類文明開始以來，樹已經少了將近一半（46%），每年還在砍掉超過 150 億棵。

資料來源：
• Crowther et al. 2015（Nature）全球樹木數量: https://www.nature.com/articles/nature14967
• FAO 森林碳儲量（FRA 2020）: https://www.fao.org/forestry-fao/industries/98951/en
• FAO《世界森林狀況 2020》: https://doi.org/10.4060/ca8642en
• Nobre 2014《The Future Climate of Amazonia》: https://www.ccst.inpe.br/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/The_Future_Climate_of_Amazonia_Report.pdf
• Global Carbon Budget 2024: https://globalcarbonbudget.org/fossil-fuel-co2-emissions-increase-again-in-2024/
• 最古老的森林（Stein et al. 2019）: https://e360.yale.edu/digest/scientists-find-the-worlds-oldest-known-forest-dating-back-386-million-years
• 聯合國《世界人口展望 2024》: https://www.un.org/development/desa/pd/world-population-prospects-2024
氧氣變化與排放年數為本片依上述資料計算。

配樂：原創（樣本 VSCO 2 CE、VCSL，CC0）

en.title: What if every tree on Earth vanished?
en.summary: If every tree vanished we would not suffocate: even if they all burned, oxygen would only drop from 20.95% to about 20.93%. The real problems are the ~300 billion tonnes of carbon in trees, the 20 billion tonnes of water Amazon trees lift into the sky each day, and the species that live in forests; and since civilization began, nearly half of all trees are already gone.

youtube.title: What if every tree on Earth vanished? Would we suffocate?
youtube.description:
If every tree vanished, we would not suffocate. The real trouble is elsewhere.

Earth has about 3 trillion trees, about 370 for every person. Even if every tree burned, oxygen in the air would only drop from 20.95% to about 20.93%; but the ~300 billion tonnes of carbon in trees and their roots equal 29 years of global fossil-fuel emissions. Every day, Amazon trees release about 20 billion tonnes of water into the sky, more than the Amazon River pours into the ocean, and forests are home to 80% of amphibian, 75% of bird and 68% of mammal species. Since human civilization began, nearly half of all trees (46%) are gone, and we still cut over 15 billion a year.

Sources:
• Crowther et al. 2015 (Nature), global tree count: https://www.nature.com/articles/nature14967
• FAO forest carbon stock (FRA 2020): https://www.fao.org/forestry-fao/industries/98951/en
• FAO, State of the World's Forests 2020: https://doi.org/10.4060/ca8642en
• Nobre 2014, The Future Climate of Amazonia: https://www.ccst.inpe.br/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/The_Future_Climate_of_Amazonia_Report.pdf
• Global Carbon Budget 2024: https://globalcarbonbudget.org/fossil-fuel-co2-emissions-increase-again-in-2024/
• Oldest known forest (Stein et al. 2019): https://e360.yale.edu/digest/scientists-find-the-worlds-oldest-known-forest-dating-back-386-million-years
• UN World Population Prospects 2024: https://www.un.org/development/desa/pd/world-population-prospects-2024
The oxygen change and emission-years are our own calculations from these sources.

Music: original score (samples: VSCO 2 CE, VCSL, CC0)

#trees #forests #climatechange #whatif #shorts

sources.label: Crowther et al. 2015, Mapping tree density at a global scale, Nature 525 (3.04 trillion trees; ~46% fewer since civilization began; over 15 billion cut per year)
FAO, Wood, wood products and climate change (FRA 2020: 662 Gt forest carbon; 45% in living biomass)
FAO & UNEP, The State of the World's Forests 2020 (habitat for 80% of amphibian, 75% of bird, 68% of mammal species)
Nobre 2014, The Future Climate of Amazonia, p. 13 (20 billion t/day transpired; Amazon River slightly over 17 billion t/day)
Yale e360 on Stein et al. 2019, Current Biology: oldest known forest, ~386 million years ago
UN DESA, World Population Prospects 2024 (~8.2 billion people in 2024)
FactCheck.org: forests consume nearly all the oxygen they produce; fires don't threaten the oxygen supply

notes:
【計算】
1) 每人棵數：3.04 兆 ÷ 82 億人 ≈ 371 → 片中「約 370 棵」。弱點：樹木數是 2015 年的估計（之後仍持續減少），人口用 2024 年；Crowther 原文以 2015 年人口算為每人約 422 棵。
2) 樹裡的碳：FAO FRA 2020 森林碳總量 662 Gt × 活生物量 45% = 297.9 Gt C ≈ 3000 億噸碳（以碳的質量計，含地上與地下的根）。弱點：這是「森林」的活生物量，含林下灌木、不含森林外的樹；Pan et al. 2011 估計約 363 Gt C，所以片中數字偏保守。
3) 化石燃料年數：GCB 2024 化石 CO2 37.4 Gt × 12.011/44.009 = 10.21 Gt C/年；297.9 ÷ 10.21 ≈ 29.2 → 29 年（以 2024 年的排放速度）。
4) 氧氣：乾空氣質量 5.135e18 kg ÷ 28.965 g/mol ≈ 1.773e20 mol；O2 佔 20.946% → 3.713e19 mol。燒掉 297.9 Gt C = 2.48e16 mol C；生物質氧化比約 1.1 → 消耗 2.73e16 mol O2。新濃度 = (3.713e19 − 2.73e16) ÷ (1.773e20 − 2.73e16 + 2.48e16) ≈ 20.931%，片中顯示 20.95% → 20.93%；相對減少約 0.073%，即「不到千分之一」。弱點：一次性簡化計算，忽略海洋交換、土壤碳與後續的生態效應。
5) 亞馬遜：Nobre 2014 第 13 頁，550 萬 km² × 3.6 mm/日 ≈ 200 億噸/日（以通量塔的蒸發散資料估算，屬粗估）；河口流量 2×10^5 m³/s × 86400 s ≈ 172.8 億噸/日。
6) 40 多億年：地球約 45.4 億歲，已知最古老的森林化石約 3.86 億年前（Stein et al. 2019）→ 約 41.5 億年沒有樹。
7) 46%、每年超過 150 億棵：Crowther et al. 2015 摘要（46% 為「人類文明開始以來」）。80%/75%/68% 是物種數的比例（FAO SOFO 2020 原文為「提供棲地」）。
【已知弱點】開場的「消失」與後段的「燒光／碳回到空氣」是不同的假設；氧氣和碳兩段在畫面上都明確寫了「就算把樹燒光」「鎖在樹裡的碳」。片中的樹木格（100 棵中 46 棵變暗）是示意圖，不是地圖。
【製作】tools/render.mjs 寫死 concurrency 12，這台機器只有 8 核心會直接報錯，所以複製了一份 films/w1015-0dhj/render.mjs（concurrency 上限為核心數）來輸出，其餘不變。配樂 100 BPM、D 小調，每個轉場都在小節線上；開場的撥弦音對準每棵樹消失的影格，碳那一段每個方塊對應一個十六分音符，『一半』那一段 marimba 跟著樹一起掉音符。
